findings.detail: FALSE. Prior tick claimed apps/pdf-extractor/infrastructure/ocr_gateway.py was 527L at HEAD with a 67L uncommitted overage, therefore the size-lint block was hostage to a dirty working tree and splitting the other two files would not unblock the push. Re-measured this tick from clean: commit 183488ca2 ('gate ocr_gateway inflight-mismatch ERROR on persistence') landed 2026-08-24T04:41:24Z — BEFORE the tick that made the claim — carrying numstat 74/7 on that exact file, taking it 527L -> 594L. HEAD is 594L and has been since 04:41Z. `git diff --numstat` on all three offenders is EMPTY (fully committed) and `git log origin/main..main -- <f>` returns exactly 1 unpushed commit for EACH of the three, so all three are inside the push range.
findings.how_the_error_happened: The reported evidence was `git show HEAD:<path> | wc -l` = 527 plus `git diff --numstat` = '74 7'. Those two are mutually inconsistent on a clean tree, and '74 7' is byte-identical to 183488ca2's own numstat — i.e. a commit-range diff was read as a working-tree diff, and the HEAD line count did not correspond to the actual HEAD. Neither number was cross-checked against `git log -- <path>` or `git status --porcelain <path>`, either of which would have falsified the finding immediately.
consequences: The size-lint block is entirely on legitimately committed, in-push-range content. Splitting the three files IS the correct unblock path, exactly as the existing sprint assumed.

FIX-SIZELINT-PREPUSH-SCANS-WORKING-TREE-NOT-PUSH-RANGE is NOT on the critical path. The script genuinely does scan the working tree (list_files() = `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard`; the loop counts `wc -l < $f`, nothing references the push range) so the row remains a valid LATENT-defect row — but it is not what is blocking the fleet, and it must not be allowed to outrank the per-file splits.

The 'serial offenders' retraction from last tick is only HALF right and stays half right: the baseline-tolerance mechanism (threshold 120L, per-file grandfather baseline, +/-10% min-5L ceiling) was verified in source and is confirmed again by the script's own output; what is wrong is only the uncommitted-file claim layered on top of it. Three offenders are failing SIMULTANEOUSLY, all committed: 252/250, 1012/996, 594/579.
